test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of NRHM?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Rural Health Mission**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Rural Health Mission (NRHM)** was launched by the Government of India in April 2005.
 
• NRHM aims to provide accessible, affordable, and quality health care to the rural population, especially the vulnerable groups.
 
• The mission focuses on strengthening the health system, improving maternal and child health, and controlling communicable and non-communicable diseases.
 
• It also emphasizes the importance of community participation and decentralized planning in the health sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NRHM was later subsumed under the **National Health Mission (NHM)** in 2013, which also includes the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM).
 
• The NHM continues to focus on health system strengthening, reproductive-maternal-newborn-child and adolescent health (RMNCH+A), and communicable and non-communicable diseases.
 
• The mission is guided by principles of decentralization, community participation, and equity in healthcare access.
 
• Several initiatives like ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist), Janani Suraksha Yojana, and Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram have been launched under NRHM to improve health indicators.
